_about: The City of Melbourne's council, hand-kept: a Lord Mayor and Deputy Lord Mayor elected together, and nine councillors elected at large (no wards), at the October 2024 election, for four years. Sources: the VEC's Melbourne City Council page and 2024 results (vec.vic.gov.au), and council minutes (February 2026), checked November 12, 2026. Check after any by-election or countback, and after the October 2028 election.
